# netbox_token (Resource)

Manages a NetBox token (`/api/users/tokens/`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "automation_password" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

resource "netbox_user" "automation" {
  username = "automation"
  password = var.automation_password
}

# The token secret is generated by NetBox and returned only by the create
# call; the current resource does not expose it (see docs/validation/virt-users.md),
# so retrieve it from the NetBox UI or create the token there. Use this
# resource to manage the token's lifecycle, expiry and write access.
resource "netbox_token" "automation_ro" {
  user_id       = netbox_user.automation.id
  description   = "Read-only CI token"
  write_enabled = false
  expires       = "2027-01-01T00:00:00Z"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `user_id` (Number) ID of the User (`netbox_user`).

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description. Defaults to an empty string.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Disable to temporarily revoke this token without deleting it. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `expires` (String) Expires. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `last_used` (String) Last Used. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `pepper_id` (Number) ID of the cryptographic pepper used to hash the token (v2 only). Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `version` (Number) Version. Valid values: `1`, `2`. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `write_enabled` (Boolean) Permit create/update/delete operations using this token. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Created.
- `display` (String) Display.
- `id` (Number) The numeric ID of the object in NetBox.
- `key` (String) The v2 token identification key (`nbt_<key>`).
- `token` (String, Sensitive) The token secret (v2: the part after the dot). Only returned by NetBox on creation; kept in state afterwards.
- `url` (String) Url.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# netbox_token is imported by its NetBox object ID (/api/users/tokens/).
terraform import netbox_token.example 123
```
